system.description:
Attuning themselves to the very bones of their haven, the thaumaturge always knows where each of their belongings rests within its walls.

While you remain within your haven, you instinctively know the location of every inanimate object you own, including objects you have successfully stolen. No challenge is required, and the attunement lasts for 24 hours. You may end the enchantment at any time. Retest with Occult.
